name: Mirage Noir
source:
Temere Mundi, winter evening.

A young local witch from a certain village placed in the mountainous region of hollow ridges, while searching for her familiar finds a strange glade deep down in the forest. Surprisingly, she finds an unconscious, worn out man, who needed immediate medical support. Ignoring her common sense, she takes him to her place and does her best, healing his wounds and frostbite. Back then, little did she know that this event will change her life forever.

Vienna, the wheat-haired white witch saved the life of a young man from a certain death from freezing. As it occurred later the white haired man named vesper couldn't remember anything from his previous life. Vienna offered to help him regain his memories, but he strongly refused, fearing that he might not like what was hidden in his past. Especially since from the very beginning of their meeting, he manifested his strange and uncommon abilities.

Days were slowly passing by turning into months and eventually years. Vesper has managed to finally find a place in the small community of Vienna's village where she fulfilled an important role of a local matron. Together they were helping the locals with their daily life issues. As the mutual bond between Vesper and Vienna tightens, they decide to spend their lives together as husband and wife.

Unfortunately, Vesper’s past finally gets in the way and their idyllic life is brutally interrupted by sudden events. Their world falls apart and Vesper will have to make some hard decisions. An unexpected journey will bring him more questions than answers. Is he going to regret his previous decision of throwing away the knowledge about his past? Will he be able to save his calm and happy life with Vienna? Not everything was as pretty as it seemed, and all carefully hidden secrets will be brought to light.

[Edited from [url=http://noire-ighaan.deviantart.com/art/Mirage-Noir-Story-Synopsis-341659394]DeviantArt[/url]]
translation:
Temere Mundi，冬天的夜晚。

一位来自某个村庄的年轻女巫被安置在空心山脊的山区，在寻找她的魔宠时，在森林深处发现了一个奇怪的空地。令人惊讶的是，她发现了一名昏迷不醒、疲惫不堪的男子，需要立即医疗救助。她无视自己的常识，带他到自己的地方，尽最大努力治愈他的伤口和冻伤。那时，她还不知道这件事将永远改变她的生活。

维也纳，小麦色头发的白女巫救了一名因冻死而死的年轻人。后来，那个名叫维斯帕的白发男子记不起前世的任何事情了。维也纳提出要帮助他恢复记忆，但他坚决拒绝，担心他可能不喜欢自己过去隐藏的东西。尤其是从一见面开始，他就展现出了他奇异而不凡的能力。

日子慢慢地过去了，变成了几个月，最终变成了几年。维斯珀终于在维也纳村庄的一个小社区找到了自己的位置，在那里她扮演了当地主妇的重要角色。他们一起帮助当地人解决日常生活问题。随着Vesper和Vienna之间的联系越来越紧密，他们决定以夫妻的身份共度一生。

不幸的是，维斯帕的过去终于成为了阻碍，他们的田园生活被突发事件残酷地打断了。他们的世界分崩离析，维斯珀将不得不做出一些艰难的决定。一次意想不到的旅程给他带来的问题多于答案。他会后悔之前抛弃有关自己过去的知识的决定吗？他能否挽救自己与维也纳平静幸福的生活呢？并非一切都像看起来那么美好，所有精心隐藏的秘密都将被揭露。
